def transform(grid):
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the colored grid separators.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            # Encode each tile by the number of marker cells: singleton -> 3,
            # repeated marker -> 1, empty -> 0. The background is most frequent.
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
            background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
            markers = sum(v != background for v in cells)
            line.append(3 if markers == 1 else 1 if markers >= 2 else 0)
        out.append(line)
    return out
